data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A–stage AI & Software company seeking valuation after raising $139M to date. The peer universe comprises 9 comparable companies across AI and software infrastructure: 1 public (Palantir, PLTR) and 8 private firms including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs, spanning Series A through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods triangulate the company's value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $278M based on total capital raised as a proxy anchor. Peer-median analysis references a cohort of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $15.3B (range: $3.2B to $29.0B), directly implying $15.3B. The substantial spread reflects heterogeneity in AI funding and late-stage inflations, with Reflection AI and Scale AI commanding $25.0B and $29.0B respectively, while Physical Intelligence and Black Forest Labs occupy the $3.2B to $5.6B band.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $236M (low) to $17.6B (high), with a median of $7.8B. The wide dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects tension between mechanistic capital-based approaches and market comparables in a high-variance frontier sector. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, unit economics, and the degree to which late-stage AI valuations reflect sustainable fundamentals versus momentum. Resolution requires granular operational disclosure.
